types.name: Odd word out
types.description: Four (sometimes five) meaningful words or names; three belong to one group by meaning and one does not.

types.name: Odd word-pair
types.description: Four word-pairs (Cow : Calf, Dog : Puppy …); three pairs share the same relationship and one pair does not.

types.name: Odd letter-cluster
types.description: Four letter-clusters such as BDF, HJL, RTW, MOQ; three follow the same letter-gap pattern and one is different.

types.name: Odd number
types.description: Four single numbers; three share a property (prime, square, cube, multiple of a number) and one does not.

types.name: Odd number-pair or set
types.description: Four number-pairs (3 – 10) or number sets (4, 9, 13) where the second number comes from the first by an operation; one pair or set does not follow it.

types.name: Odd figure
types.description: Four or five figures; all but one are alike in some way (rotation, count of lines, shading) and the odd figure must be chosen.
